interpretation: Within-context-cohort variance of P-T(P) equals T(P) variance for fixed P. Common correction variance remains a mixture of pilot fluctuations, deterministic native settling and input/guide transfer. Cohort covariance alone is not pilot-noise causation.

dominant_shared_pilot_limit.qualification: Repeated-context averaging cannot remove shared P fluctuations. This diagnoses native context contribution, not a material/wave solution; dominant pilot noise still needs a separate source-pilot hypothesis.
